title: [DocDB][B&R][Packed Columns] Failed to write a batch with 0 operations into RocksDB: Corruption (yb/docdb/docdb_compaction_context.cc:132): Double packed rows:
body:
Jira Link: [DB-3345](https://yugabyte.atlassian.net/browse/DB-3345)
### Description

On my [puppy-food-arm-1](https://portal.dev.yugabyte.com/universes/01559475-2aac-4cda-9ac8-fd971f17b622/nodes) universe with 2.15.3.0-b77 version and these gflags:
![Screenshot 2022-09-02 at 18 35 54](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/2335377/188199401-75503588-ed94-4c09-8423-0a041b7f2de5.png)
![Screenshot 2022-09-02 at 18 38 13](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/2335377/188199461-babe73f2-0bf8-49b6-99e7-5e0f1f3ff676.png)
I just got a master FATAL with corruption following a backup with workloads still running:
```
[yugabyte@ip-10-9-82-24 logs]$ cat yb-master.FATAL.details.2022-09-02T16_32_05.pid376445.txt
F20220902 16:32:05 ../../src/yb/tablet/tablet.cc:1348] T 00000000000000000000000000000000 P d2d9ca80ccd441c0b92c6f9d70e7b099: Failed to write a batch with 0 operations into RocksDB: Corruption (yb/docdb/docdb_compaction_context.cc:132): Double packed rows: 4880000001533030303033336536303030303330303038303030303030303030303034613061000021, 48800000015330303030333365363030303033303030383030303030303030303030346130610000212380016C907786112F804A0100000000000000

    @     0xffffbb2cb018  yb::tablet::Tablet::ApplyRowOperations()
    @     0xffffbb37e528  yb::tablet::WriteOperation::DoReplicated()

```
Backup of YCQL finished at 16:25:
![Screenshot 2022-09-02 at 18 41 22](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/2335377/188199972-8db6ff31-671c-40f8-87a5-c785b5589cdd.png)
Crashes started at 16:26:
```
-rw-r--r--. 1 yugabyte yugabyte 2.2K Sep  2 16:32 yb-master.FATAL.details.2022-09-02T16_32_05.pid376445.txt

-rw-rw-r--. 1 yugabyte yugabyte 1.9K Sep  2 16:26 yb-master.FATAL.details.2022-09-02T16_26_02.pid1357.txt
```
Not sure if we want to consider this as a duplicate of https://github.com/yugabyte/yugabyte-db/issues/12813 or a new bug, depends on if there is a new root cause I guess. Previously I always had this with YSQL, not it seems it happened after the YCQL backup, so might be YCQL related.
I will keep the server in this state for debugging until told otherwise.
